facts.value: Restores facing_dir from specialn_facing_dir and converts x19A4 to s32. Only if that converted integer is positive does it write (s32)(integer * MarsAttributes.x5C) to mv.ms.speciallw.x0; otherwise the previous value survives. It obtains the hip position, passes it with 120, 0.9, 0.02 and M_PI/3 to lb_800119DC, and selects motion state 370 for GA_Ground or 372 otherwise. The inline tail conditionally spawns right-shoulder effect 1265 for MARS or 1296 for EMBLEM, then clears pre_hitlag_cb, post_hitlag_cb and accessory4_cb. Positive speciallw.x0 is subsequently consumed by EMBLEM-only enabled-capsule updates in both hit animations.
facts.rationale: Preserves conversion order, guarded write lifetime, concrete effect selection and downstream consumption without equating the input value to final hit damage.

evidence.why: Grounded and aerial consumers of the stored value.

facts.value: Invocation enters state 370 when ground_or_air equals GA_Ground and state 372 otherwise, with frame 0, rate 1 and zero preservation flags. The retaliation value is refreshed only when (s32)x19A4 is positive; a failed guard leaves the previous speciallw.x0 unchanged. Fresh stance entries initialize that field to zero, but this callback does not enforce that prior value. If x2219_b0 is clear, MARS and EMBLEM spawn their respective shoulder effects; other kinds spawn nothing, and all switch paths then set the latch. An already-set latch skips spawning. pre_hitlag_cb, post_hitlag_cb and accessory4_cb are cleared regardless of latch or kind.
facts.rationale: Corrects the original scalar-positivity shortcut and preserves the default-kind and prior-state branches.

evidence.why: Exact guards, default branch, state arguments and unconditional cleanup.
